description: Source code for an asynchronous UDP multicast receiver handling events and IPC responses, including socket setup, thread management, and callback invocation.

methods.name: zhalAsyncReceiverStart
methods.description: Initializes and starts the async receiver thread, setting up IPC and event handlers.

methods.name: zhalAsyncReceiverStop
methods.description: Stops the async receiver thread, cleans up resources, and signals thread termination.

methods.name: setupAsyncSocket
methods.description: Creates, configures, binds, and joins multicast group on UDP socket for event listening.

methods.name: asyncReceiverThreadProc
methods.description: Main thread procedure for receiving multicast UDP packets, parsing JSON, and dispatching callbacks.

methods.name: invokeIpcHandlerCallback
methods.description: Invokes the IPC response handler callback with received JSON data.

methods.name: invokeEventHandlerCallback
methods.description: Invokes the event handler callback with received JSON data.
